unit: characters of instruction text one PR run loads into its main session
note: limit = the ceiling check.py enforces now; target = where the route has to end up. Lower a limit whenever a route shrinks; raising one needs a reason in the PR. polish, review, compat-check, and unslop run in subagents (go, branch-pr, and monitor launch them), so their bodies are not in any route.

session-start.note: what every session pays before its first word, and again on every later turn as cache reads: the session hook's text and the listed name (gbase:<name>) and description of each gbase skill, agent, and command the model sees (a skill with disable-model-invocation is not listed). 15,836 characters in gbase 1.75.1, 6,036 tokens over no plugin at turn 1 (claude -p, isolated config); 1.77.0 cut it to 11,420 characters

headless.note: an unattended run settles the PR instead of watching it, and reviews low-risk changes before the PR

merge.note: go --draft or --merge, or a finding review deferred

playbook.note: a route that follows a pstack playbook reads work's playbooks.md and one playbook (831 to 4,466 characters; feature.md stands in)

preview.note: the owner reads a preview before the PR: the environment file's `before the PR: preview`, or --preview; a run without either reads nothing more

held-replies.note: the user posts their own replies to reviewers: the environment file's `review replies: draft`, or --hold-replies, and only once the PR has a comment; a run without either reads nothing more

review-policy.note: the environment file names reviewers, labels, a commit sign-off, or a PR size for every PR (ship-prep prints `review policy:`); a run without any reads nothing more

ticket.note: a ticket reference in the request or branch, in a repo whose owner set an environment file (git config gbase.conventions); the file itself is the user's and is not counted

ui.note: a change to what a user sees

deltas.note: one of go's parallel stages changed something the other never read (stage-delta's next: names the file); a run where neither did reads nothing more
